request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:3

layers.text: Change only the colours and the flag: the big red tent and the small red tents become dull mid-brown patched hide (#955627, shadows #562a0c) with darker stitched patches; remove the red flag, leaving the bare pole on the big tent; the red roof panels of the grey huts become rusted iron sheets (#8a4a2a); the huts stay dull gunmetal scrap; no red left. Keep every building's shape and place, the chimneys and smoke, the size, black outline and art style the same.
